description: Leverage Microsoft.CodeAnalysis Refactoring APIs to replace or enhance rt's custom extract-method, inline-method, and extract-class implementations. epics.title: Leverage Roslyn Refactoring APIs
epics.description: Systematically audit rt's extract-method, inline-method, and extract-class commands against Roslyn's built-in Refactoring APIs. Replace or enhance custom implementations where Roslyn provides proven, battle-tested logic.
epics.notes: Blocked by: US-029 (semantic validation fix), US-032 (parameterization). High-value follow-ups: reduces parameterization dev time from 4-6h to 2-3h; unblocks future inline/extract-class quality improvements.
